applicability_rule: APPLICABLE to any Tested Code, unconditionally. The subject clause is bare 'Tested code' with no restriction, and -- unlike req-1-eip155-chainid and req-2-overflow-underflow below -- a manual re-read of the full predicate ('use a Solidity compiler version older than 0.8.0') confirms there is no hidden predicate-embedded restriction either: every piece of Tested Code is compiled with SOME solc version, so the condition 'which version was used' applies universally by construction.

derivation_log_entry.basis_classification_rationale: Direct entailment from the unconditioned subject clause, cross-checked against the full predicate text specifically because AR-001 flagged that 'unconditioned subject' alone isn't sufficient evidence of true universal applicability -- confirmed here that no predicate-embedded restriction exists, unlike two other requirements in this tranche.
derivation_log_entry.derivation_method: manual re-read of full normative_text against AR-001's warning
